literal_meaning: ছোট জাত (low caste or small birth)
figurative_meaning_en: socially ostracized or untouchable in society
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ছোটজাত বলে গ্রামে কেউ তার সাথে বিয়ে দেয় না।
ছোটজাতের ছেলেকে স্কুলে আলাদা করে বসানো হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is shunned in the village for being low caste and no one will marry him off.
The lowborn boy is made to sit separately in school.
history: This idiom reflects the historical caste hierarchy in Bengali society, influenced by Hindu varna system, where lower castes were marginalized socially and economically.
note: Primarily used in contexts discussing traditional social inequalities in Bengal.
